questions.q: In which year did Indonesia declare independence?
questions.why: Sukarno read the proclamation on 17 August.

questions.q: Who was Indonesia's first President?
questions.why: He led the independence movement.

questions.q: Which European country colonised Indonesia?
questions.why: It was called the Dutch East Indies.

questions.q: Which huge Buddhist temple stands in Central Java?
questions.why: It is the world's largest Buddhist temple.

questions.q: Which president ruled Indonesia from 1967 to 1998?
questions.why: His era was called the New Order.

questions.q: Which 'Spice Islands' drew Europeans to Indonesia?
questions.why: They grew nutmeg and cloves.

questions.q: What is Indonesia's national motto?
questions.why: It means 'Unity in Diversity'.

questions.q: Which Hindu temple complex near Yogyakarta is a UNESCO site?
questions.why: It honours Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva.

questions.q: Which Javanese empire ruled much of the archipelago in the 1300s?
questions.why: Its minister Gajah Mada vowed to unite the islands.

questions.q: What are Indonesia's five founding principles called?
questions.why: Sukarno set them out in 1945.

questions.q: Who became Indonesia's first woman President, in 2001?
questions.why: She is Sukarno's daughter.

questions.q: Which volcano's 1815 eruption caused the 'Year Without a Summer'?
questions.why: It was the largest eruption in recorded history.

questions.q: Which Sumatran kingdom was a Buddhist sea power from the 600s?
questions.why: It controlled the Strait of Malacca.

questions.q: Which volcano's 1883 eruption was heard thousands of kilometres away?
questions.why: It lies in the Sunda Strait.

questions.q: Who became Indonesia's President in 2024?
questions.why: He succeeded Joko Widodo.

questions.q: Which city has long been Indonesia's capital?
questions.why: A new capital, Nusantara, is being built on Borneo.

questions.q: Which island is famous for Hindu temples and rice terraces?
questions.why: Most Balinese are Hindu.

questions.q: Which giant lizard lives on Komodo Island?
questions.why: It is the world's largest lizard.

questions.q: Which fried rice dish is a national favourite?
questions.why: It is often topped with a fried egg.

questions.q: Which wax-resist dyed cloth is Indonesian heritage?
questions.why: UNESCO listed it in 2009.

questions.q: Which is the world's most populous island?
questions.why: More than half of Indonesians live there.

questions.q: What is Indonesia's currency?
questions.why: Its code is IDR.

questions.q: Which great ape lives in the forests of Sumatra and Borneo?
questions.why: Its name means 'person of the forest'.

questions.q: Which shadow puppet theatre is a Javanese tradition?
questions.why: UNESCO listed it in 2003.

questions.q: Which salad of vegetables in peanut sauce is popular?
questions.why: Its name means 'mix-mix'.

questions.q: Roughly how many islands does Indonesia have?
questions.why: It is the world's largest archipelago country.

questions.q: Which ensemble of gongs and metallophones comes from Java and Bali?
questions.why: It accompanies dance and puppetry.

questions.q: Which bamboo instrument from West Java is on UNESCO's list?
questions.why: Each bamboo tube plays one note.

questions.q: What is Indonesia's highest mountain?
questions.why: It is in Papua and has glaciers.

questions.q: Which Sumatran lake fills a huge supervolcano caldera?
questions.why: Samosir Island lies in its middle.
